comment: Commercial draft templates for the inclusions/exclusions sheet (phase E2). Edit freely - the generator merges these defaults with derived lines from the estimate definition (schedule/travel/downtime/supervision markers) and with vendor-quote inclusions/exclusions. Items are provenance-labeled template sentences, not cost data.
inclusions_default: All labor shown on the recap is included: catalog unit-card task hours wrapped with N01 working-foreman and N02 non-working supervision hours.
Line-risk contingency (N05) is carried per line by catalog source quality: P 3% / E 7% / G 10% of line labor; E-flagged norms are tracked in the estimate's assumption register.
Project management (I05) at 10% of accepted labor, overhead and profit per the estimate rate card are included in the recap total.
Builder's all-risk insurance, warranty (1 year) and standard cleanup/debris removal during the N04 cleanup crew-days are included.
Mounting hardware, splitters/tappers/couplers, connectors, grounding bars and annunciation panels shown in the estimate lines are included.
exclusions_default: Sales/use tax: not included; applied at invoice per governing jurisdiction.
Permits, utility locate fees, inspection fees and AHJ-mandated witness tests beyond the listed scope.
Structural steel, new penetrations requiring fire-stopping materials, and any landlord-required union jurisdictions.
Owner-furnished materials installation unless the materials appear as estimate lines.
After-hours building access fees, freight-elevator deposits and security-escort costs beyond the constrained-access allowance (M07).
Escalation on labor or materials beyond the quote/validity period; price-hold dates govern.
RF design, iBwave prediction package, commissioning sweep reports and final as-builts (design deliverables are a separate line item).
inclusions_note: Derived lines below the template block are generated from this estimate's definition and its bound quote register; vendor-tagged lines come verbatim from vendor quotes.
exclusions_note: Derived lines below the template block are generated from this estimate's definition and its bound quote register; vendor-tagged lines come verbatim from vendor quotes.
